name: Home Alone: meet four crossover visitors and claim the Rig
description: Play First Night Story, complete household tasks until the crossover tracker reaches 4/4, then claim Anomaly Detection Rig inside the Home Alone house on Hub Floor 4.
steps: Join Home Alone Anomalies and select First Night in Story mode. The recorded run uses one player; the creator says other players are optional. Close the initial panels to enter the house.

Do household tasks while time advances and watch for crossover visitors. The video shows four visitors appearing during the night. Their exact identities and spawn times are not established as a universal schedule; the creator’s 3 a.m. and 4 a.m. sightings are examples.

Check the house notice board for the crossover-character tracker. Meet all four until it reads 4/4. The official objective is four characters, not surviving every night, buying equipment or collecting four ordinary household anomalies.

Wait for Crossover Hunter [The Hollow] to be awarded. Its official badge ID is 434944108901978. AFK completion is unverified: the creator completes tasks while waiting, so do not assume standing idle is sufficient.

Return to The Hollow hub and review any REDEEM BADGES prompt. The creator reports 10 Tickets in this run; that number is not a guaranteed current payout. The avatar item still has a separate claim location.

Take the cinema elevator to Floor 4 and find the Home Alone house room. Enter the house and use its reward display. The recording shows the Roblox Presents Anomaly Detection Rig badge award after the house claim at about 3:00. Check avatar inventory separately; this is a layered-clothing item and fit can vary by avatar. This site has not performed an own-account claim.
prerequisites: Access to Home Alone Anomalies and Hub Floor 4.
tips: Check the notice board instead of guessing which normal visitors count.
The Floor 4 Home Alone house is separate from the 99 Nights tile-puzzle room.
troubleshooting: If only 3/4 count, continue the night and check the notice board after the next crossover appearance. Exact guaranteed spawn times are not verified.
If the plaza podium is empty, follow the recorded Floor 4 house claim route rather than assuming the badge failed. Check both the original-game badge and your avatar inventory.

name: 99 Nights: level 3 fire, 20 Void flowers and chain claim
description: Upgrade the fire to level 3, follow the Void tracker, collect 20 red flowers using lantern safe zones, then return to the hub’s chain display. Omnipotence is not required.
steps: Join 99 Nights in the Forest and open The Hollow event button. Enter a normal game, chop trees with your axe, store logs in your bag and deposit them into the campfire until it reaches level 3. On the recorded desktop controls, F stores and drops logs.

At fire level 3, use The Hollow menu’s Find the Void tracker to locate the portal in the expanded zone. Stand on its platform and wait for the teleport countdown. Do not copy the creator’s cave position as a universal map coordinate.

Inside the Void, collect all 20 outlined red flowers. Approach a flower and use its interaction prompt (E in the desktop recording). Move between flowers and the yellow lantern areas, which the official badge description identifies as safe zones.

Choose an available upgrade after every three collected flowers. The recordings show options such as more lanterns, faster tree cutting and a speed boost after picking flowers; the available choices may differ. Use lanterns when enemies gather rather than trying to fight every spawn.

Some flowers are enclosed by Hollow trees. Cocajola’s recording shows cutting through the surrounding trees, with an upgrade that later reduces the chopping needed. Return to a lantern when threatened and continue from the same opening; do not mistake an enclosed flower for a missing collectible.

Collect the final flower and finish the cutscene. Check that you earned The Hollow 2026 badge, ID 2195398371010118. Dying in the Void returns you to the fire and allows another try, according to the official description; persistence of flower progress after death was not independently verified.

Return to The Hollow hub. If REDEEM BADGES appears, review the listed credits and press Confirm. Cocajola reports 10 Tickets in that recorded run; this is not a guaranteed current payout or a repeatable farming claim.

In the hub plaza, find the green 99 Nights in the Forest doorway and use the chain reward display beside it. SharkBlox’s recording shows Chrome Deer Skull Chain, Quest Reward and AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED at 3:41. Check your avatar inventory as a separate final confirmation; this site did not claim it on its own account.
prerequisites: Access to 99 Nights in the Forest and its Hollow event mode.
Axe and bag for fueling the campfire; ordinary-map equipment can help in the Void.
tips: The event badge permits lantern safe zones. Omnipotence is a separate optional challenge whose official description explicitly says it is NOT part of The Hollow event.
Taking friends is a creator recommendation, not an established requirement. The recordings also demonstrate solo play.
troubleshooting: If you cannot find the Void, first reach fire level 3, then reopen The Hollow tracker.

If the hub reward is missing, verify the exact The Hollow 2026 badge and return to the green 99 Nights doorway’s display. The early Cocajola recording had an empty podium; the later SharkBlox recording demonstrates a successful claim. Neither is a universal server-fix claim.
Do not confuse the 99 Nights Void quest with the Floor 4 Hub tile puzzle: the latter rewards Boo & Bub, not this chain.

name: Night 4: follow the tile path and earn Boo & Bub
description: Find the 99 Nights room on Floor 4, repeat the demonstrated tile path, collect the relic and return to the elevator. Includes retry and inventory checks.
steps: Enter the cinema elevator in The Hollow and select Floor 4. Explore the maze until you find the 99 Nights in the Forest room with a tiled floor and red laser barrier. The recording does not establish one fixed corridor route for every run.

Stop at the puzzle entrance and watch the demonstration character cross the tiles. Note the order of the glowing tiles from your starting side. Follow that demonstrated path rather than jumping over the red barrier or guessing a universal left/right code.

Walk the same tile sequence. If you step incorrectly, return to the start and watch the demonstration again; the video shows a failed attempt followed by a successful retry. Copy the path shown in your own puzzle.
Reach the far end and collect the relic. The video calls it a key and shows the message “Lovely! That’s another one safely in our hands!” with the floor lit green. Do not leave before collecting it.
Carry the relic back through the maze to the elevator, avoiding the Deer. Use the return route you remembered on entry; reaching the far side of the tile puzzle alone does not finish the run.

After returning, check the Boo & Bub badge and your avatar inventory separately. The creator shows Boo & Bub by Roblox with Item Owned at 1:37. That verifies the recorded account’s result, not delivery to every account or a playtest by this site.
prerequisites: Access to Floor 4 in The Hollow hub.
Full 1:42 original transcript and puzzle, relic and ownership frames reviewed October 26 Beijing.
tips: Watch a complete demonstration before moving. Memorize the route from the entrance rather than from a rotated camera view.
No Ticket payment or Plus purchase appears in the recorded maze route.
troubleshooting: If the puzzle resets, watch the demonstration again and follow its tile order; do not treat the laser barrier as a jumping challenge.
If the item is missing, first check whether you collected the relic and returned to the elevator. Check badge and avatar inventory independently; a universal delivery fix has not been verified.

name: Demonology: six relics, ritual and Biter Fedora
description: Collect the mirror, lantern, book, hourglass, lock and skull; complete the ritual and portal, then claim Biter Fedora in the hub.
steps: In Demonology, click The Hollow sticky notes at the top right and load into the event game. Follow the red marker on the compass at the top of the screen to find the altar. Avoid the monster while collecting the six relics.
Mirror: follow the mirror as it jumps between pedestals until you can collect it. In the recording it turns purple when obtained. Pick it up, equip it and bring it back to the altar.
Lantern: pick up the spectral flame and light the three lamps by holding the interaction key (E in the recording). Collect the lantern that appears in the middle and return it to the altar.
Book: interact with and read each sign in the area. Reading the final sign spawns the book; collect it and bring it to the altar.
Hourglass: stand inside the moving circle and walk with it. Stay inside until its progress indicator fills, then collect the hourglass and return it to the altar.

Lock: find the locked fence, then search nearby containers for a lockpick. Use it on the lock and click when the moving cursor is on the red segment of the minigame. Collect the lock relic and return it to the altar. The lockpick container in the video is an example, not a guaranteed spawn for every run.
Skull: pick up the shovel, dig the fresh grave, retrieve the skull and return it to the altar. Check that all six relics have been placed; carrying the final relic is not enough.
Begin the ritual, let the cutscene finish and walk into the portal. The creator reports receiving the Demonology event badge at this point.

Return to The Hollow hub on the same account. Look to the left for the Biter Fedora display by the green-lit entrance and interact with Claim. Check your avatar inventory afterward. The recording shows the Claim prompt; successful inventory delivery has not been independently tested here.
tips: Return each relic to the altar and use the on-screen counter to check progress. The recording shows separate carried-item and altar-placement states.
Use the red compass marker to orient yourself; no fixed map route or guaranteed completion time is established.
No Ticket purchase or Plus requirement appears in the recorded quest route.
troubleshooting: Ritual unavailable: check that all six relics were placed on the altar, including the skull.
Hourglass not appearing: stay inside the moving circle until progress completes. For the lantern, light all three lamps.
After the ritual, enter the portal before leaving. Then visit the hub Claim display; earning a badge and receiving an avatar item are separate checks.
prerequisites: Access to the Demonology Hollow event mode.
Original video reviewed October 25; community-recorded walkthrough, not an account playtest.

name: Dead Rails: Edison’s Revenge and Cowboy Hat of the Dead
description: Find the stain key, unlock the bank vault, defeat the prison boss and finish the train, then claim the hat in the hub’s Floor 3 Dead Rails room.
steps: In Dead Rails, press Play and choose Edison’s Revenge, the second option in the recording. Search the walls around spawn for Investigate the stain. Interact, collect the key that appears below you, and use it on the train lock.
Enter the changed train and move through its carriages. Pick up weapons and ammunition along the way. At the first locked door, go outside and defeat enemies until you obtain the bank combination.

Take the combination into the bank. Click and drag the vault wheel clockwise to each successive number on your paper. The video uses 55434; use your own combination rather than treating this as a universal code. Collect the key inside and unlock the train door.

Continue to the next locked door and fight the enemies outside. The creator recommends finding a rifle before this section. After clearing the ordinary enemies, enter the prison and interact with the key on the rock.

Pulling the prison key triggers a boss fight. Defeat the boss, retrieve the key, return to the train and unlock the next door. Continue to the final carriage and cutscene; the creator reports receiving the event badge after being teleported back.

Return to The Hollow hub on the same account. Take the cinema elevator to Floor 3, explore until you find the Dead Rails room, and interact with the cowboy-hat display on the left. Check your avatar inventory after claiming. The video shows the display and describes claiming; independent inventory delivery has not been tested here.
tips: Collect ammunition before leaving the train. The creator found the revolver challenging and recommends a rifle.
The bank combination is an in-game puzzle, not a redeem code. No Ticket purchase or Plus requirement appears in this recorded quest route.
troubleshooting: Wrong vault combination: read the dropped paper and enter its numbers clockwise in order. Do not assume the example 55434 applies.
At the prison, pulling the key is not the end: defeat the boss and take the key before returning to the locked train door.
Completing Dead Rails and claiming the avatar item are separate steps. If no hat arrives, check the event badge and then visit the Floor 3 display; no universal delivery fix is verified.
prerequisites: Access to Dead Rails Edison’s Revenge and the hub’s Floor 3.
Community video reviewed October 25; not an account playtest.

name: Night 3: grave ages, coffin code and Festering Felix
description: Solve Floor 3 by comparing eight lifespans, enter the three youngest grave symbols, and bring the relic back to the elevator. Includes the order rule and claim checks.
steps: Enter the hub cinema elevator and choose Floor 3. Explore until you reach the Demonology room with a coffin in the middle and eight graves around it. No identical maze route for every run is established.
Read the riddle beside the coffin. It asks for the three shortest lives, ordered from youngest to oldest, rather than the earliest birth or death years.

Record the symbol, birth date and death date on each of the eight graves. Calculate each lifespan, then sort the eight from shortest to longest. Use the full displayed dates if needed; do not rank by death date alone.

Take the symbols of the three youngest people in that order. At the coffin, use the arrows on Grave Lock slots I, II and III to match those three symbols from left to right. The video uses broom, witch and ghost; that is the recorded example, not a verified universal code.
Press Open. The recording shows the relic collected and a Got it message. If the coffin does not open, recheck all eight lifespans and the order of the three selected symbols.

Carry the relic safely back to the elevator. The video shows the return and reports the Festering Felix badge and avatar reward. Check both your badge list and avatar inventory; opening the coffin alone is not the final step. Inventory delivery was not independently tested on our account.
tips: Write a small table: symbol | birth | death | lifespan. Sort by lifespan ascending and use the first three rows.
No Ticket payment or Plus purchase appears in the recorded puzzle route. This is a maze puzzle, not a redeemable promo code.
troubleshooting: Do not copy the example symbols without checking your graves. If dates are close, compare full dates rather than rounded ages.
If the reward is missing, verify you collected the relic and returned to the elevator. Check badge and inventory separately; no universal delivery fix is established.
prerequisites: Access to Floor 3 event content.
Full original video transcript and key frames reviewed October 25 (Beijing); community-recorded walkthrough, not our account playtest.

name: Sell Lemons: five sticker packs and the manual badge claim
description: Build the Halloween factory, earn Spooky Coins, open five sticker packs and claim the badge before checking Hollow Tickets.
prerequisites: Enter Sell Lemons through The Hollow Visit Games menu, using the same Roblox account. Its official root place is 79268393072444.
Reviewed from KAM Gats’s October 23 recording and official badge API on October 24; not our own account playtest.
steps: Enter the Halloween area and claim a factory plot. Build its production equipment and trade the candy it makes for Spooky Coins. The event panel explicitly separates candy, Spooky Coins and stickers.

Save enough for five Halloween sticker packs. The creator reports 1,000 coins per pack, or 5,000 total for the packs; factory construction is separate. These are Sell Lemons coins, not Hollow Tickets or Robux.
Go to the STICKERS stall and open five packs. The objective counts packs opened; you do not need to finish the sticker collection. Check the event counter as you open them.
Open the pumpkin EVENT button on the right, then The Hollow panel. Once it shows 5/5 packs opened, select Claim. The recording shows CLAIMED at about 8:01.
Check for Spooky Sticker Collector, badge ID 115007543086503. The official badge description independently confirms the five Halloween-pack objective.

Return to The Hollow and read the reward confirmation before selecting Confirm. At 8:10 this recording shows a 40-Ticket offer. Treat that as the amount offered in this recorded return, not a guaranteed repeatable payout or proof that all 40 came from the badge alone. Verify your balance afterward.
tips: Video: 7:12–7:40 Halloween area and factory; 7:40–7:56 sticker shop; 7:56–8:05 manual badge claim; 8:05–8:16 return to the hub.
No Plus requirement or Robux purchase is shown for this route. Earning the in-game coins still takes play time; the edited video is not a completion-time estimate.
troubleshooting: Five opened packs but no badge? Return to the EVENT → The Hollow panel and use Claim; leaving immediately after opening packs skips the demonstrated final step.

Badge owned but no Tickets? Check the Hollow confirmation and balance separately. Sell Lemons credit failures have been reported; badge ownership is not proof of delivery. Rebuying packs or rejoining is not a verified fix.
If your shop price or reward offer differs, use the current in-game display. Do not spend Robux based on the coin amount in this guide.

name: The Hollow Survive Overnight in a Mega Store: A Tasty Brew Badge Guide
description: Brew the event recipe for A Tasty Brew. Roblox confirms the badge; the 18-candy walkthrough and 20-Ticket reward are reported by Pro Game Guides, not independently playtested.
prerequisites: Open Survive Overnight in a Mega Store, Roblox place 127380660530951. Its developer explicitly identifies it as participating in The Hollow.
The official badge confirms brewing a special recipe in a witch’s cauldron. The detailed route below is REPORTED; no independent account playtest has been completed.
steps: Join a lobby through a portal on the main screen. Locate the entrance cauldron and read its three candy counters: the reported recipe needs six of each type.

Scout chest locations by day: from the cauldron, walk ahead and left into the weapons area; also check the middle corridor and the graveyard at the back. PGG documents these landmarks; treat them as search areas, not a guaranteed spawn in every server.
Open pumpkin chests at night. In daytime, visit the rear graveyard, lift coffin lids and move them aside to search inside for candy.

Return to the cauldron in batches. TechWiser reports five inventory slots: you cannot carry all 18 candies together. Equip a candy, approach the cauldron and press G on keyboard to drop it in. Mobile and controller inputs have not been verified; use the displayed interaction prompt.
Check each counter separately after depositing. Once all three types reach six, interact to stir. TechWiser reports roughly ten seconds of stirring; use daytime to reduce interruptions.

Check Roblox badges for The Hollow - A Tasty Brew (1102899885295859). Return to The Hollow, inspect any badge-credit prompt and check your Ticket balance separately. The reported 20 Tickets are not a guaranteed delivery or repeatable payout.
tips: PGG supplies the lobby, landmarks and day/night search route. TechWiser supplies the inventory limit and keyboard deposit control. These are attributed walkthroughs, not our account playtest.
troubleshooting: Chest will not open? The reported route requires night for pumpkin chests; coffin searches are available by day.
Recipe will not finish? Read all three counters: extra candy of one type does not replace a missing type.
No room to collect more? Deposit your current candy batch at the entrance cauldron, then resume searching.
Badge awarded but no Tickets? Use the hub confirmation and balance checks. Repeating the recipe is not a verified credit fix.

name: AO ONI Nightmare: 50 pumpkins and Fuwatty Side Satchel
description: Step-by-step task guide: Collect 50 event pumpkins in AO ONI Nightmare, then find its reward room on Floor 2 of The Hollow.
steps: In AO ONI Nightmare, walk into a side room and create a lobby or join an existing one.
Wait a few seconds for event pumpkins to appear. Interact with pumpkins around the map while avoiding monsters.
Collect the initial pumpkins and the new wave that appears when the game mode begins. Track the event counter toward 50 pumpkins.

The creator rejoins after collecting the available wave and reports progress accumulating to 50. Check that your counter persists before using this strategy; the claim that no more pumpkins spawn is specific to that recording.
After reaching 50 and receiving the event badge, return to The Hollow. Take the elevator to Floor 2 and locate the AO ONI Nightmare reward room.

Use that room’s reward interaction and check for Fuwatty Side Satchel in avatar inventory. The recording shows a banana-shaped display while the creator reports the satchel claim; verify the room and item result rather than relying on the display model.
tips: 3:51–4:21 lobby and collection; 4:21–5:01 waves and 50 total; 5:01–5:27 Floor 2 claim and display mismatch.
troubleshooting: The banana display mismatch is a recorded launch issue, not evidence that a later-night banana reward is unlocked.
If the claim is locked or inventory does not update, check badge ownership on the same account. No guaranteed workaround or repeatable Ticket farming is verified.
prerequisites: Access to the Night 2 event content on the same Roblox account used in the hub.

name: Dandy’s World: 200 pumpkins and Reeling Petal Garland
description: Step-by-step task guide: Use the limited-time Hollow mode, accumulate 200 pumpkins, then claim the garland in the hub.
steps: In Dandy’s World, go to the left side of the lobby and enter the limited-time Hollow mode. Join its queue to start a round.
Complete machines, avoid monsters and work toward the exit. Collect pumpkins from the floor as you move.
The recording reports 1 pumpkin per floor pickup, 25 per completed machine and 50 per escape. Machines use a timing puzzle; finish all required machines to open the escape route.
Continue across rounds until the event pumpkin total reaches 200 and the event badge is awarded. This is cumulative in the reviewed guide, not a requirement to pick up 200 loose pumpkins in one run.
Return to The Hollow on the same account. Use the Dandy’s World reward display on the left side of the hub to claim Reeling Petal Garland, then check avatar inventory.
tips: 2:30–2:55 event mode and queue; 2:55–3:36 pumpkin methods; 3:36–3:51 hub claim.
Machine completion and escapes contribute much more than individual pickups in the recorded guide.
troubleshooting: Use the Hollow event mode, not an unrelated ordinary badge or currency counter.
A 200-pumpkin badge and the hub avatar-item claim are separate steps. Check the event badge before repeating rounds.
prerequisites: Access to the Night 2 event content on the same Roblox account used in the hub.
Video walkthrough reviewed October 24 (Beijing); not an independent account playtest.

name: Night 2 maze: six pillars and Witches Brew-nado
description: Follow five annotated gameplay pictures from the Dandy-themed room to the pillars, target symbol and lever, then return the relic to the elevator. Includes a linked-rotation explanation and timestamped video.
steps: Enter The Hollow hub cinema and take the elevator to Floor 2. In the recorded route, the Dandy-themed room is ahead through the right side of the open room. Look for flower furniture and rainbow wall trim, then go upstairs to the tall pillars on the purple floor. Use the annotated pictures above if the text alone is unclear; the recording does not establish an identical maze layout for everyone.
There are six pillars with four symbols each. Rotate one until it lights up to identify the target symbol. The creator’s target is a cat; do not assume every run uses that symbol.

Use a deliberate trial rather than turning every pillar at once: choose one control, rotate it once, and note every pillar that changes. Check the newly visible symbols before touching the next control. This is a suggested way to track the linked rotations, not a verified universal solution sequence.

Work toward the glowing target on all six pillars. If a turn changes a pillar you already aligned, include that linked pillar in your next adjustment. The linked-turn demonstration is at 1:28 in the linked video; the exact control-to-pillar mapping has not been independently established here.
When all six energy beams point into the middle, pull the central lever and collect the relic.

Return safely to the elevator with the relic. The creator identifies this return as the Witches Brew-nado reward trigger. Check your badge and avatar inventory; solving the pillars alone is not the final step.
tips: Picture checkpoints: 0:56 Dandy room; 1:03 upstairs puzzle entrance; 1:19 lit target face; 2:05 inward energy paths; 2:10 lever. The creator reports around nine minutes for this run, not a guaranteed completion time.
Do not confuse this hub-floor puzzle with the separate Dandy’s World 200-pumpkin quest.
troubleshooting: No universal button sequence is established. Use the glowing target and observe the linked rotations.
If no reward arrives, first check that you took the relic and reached the elevator; no universal delivery fix is verified.
prerequisites: Access to the Night 2 event content on the same Roblox account used in the hub.
Video walkthrough reviewed October 24 (Beijing); not an independent account playtest.

name: Night 1 maze: five relics and Lord Umberhallow BLOXikin
description: Find five purple relics, solve the vault connection puzzle and return to the elevator. A written route through the objectives, checked against WaffleTrades’ October 23 recording.
steps: Enter the cinema in The Hollow and use the elevator at the back to reach Floor 1.
Search different rooms for five glowing purple relics while avoiding Seek. The demonstrated layout is variable: follow unexplored branches rather than a fixed left/right sequence.
After collecting all five, locate the large room and its side room leading to the DOORS area. Find the vault there.
Complete the vault puzzle by connecting the purple line across to the other side. Take the revealed relic/key.
Return to the elevator with the key. The walkthrough identifies this return as the completion trigger for the Lord Umberhallow BLOXikin badge and reward.
tips: WaffleTrades: 0:09–0:58 relic hunt; 0:58–1:23 vault and key; 1:23–1:30 elevator return.
The relics trail behind the character in the demonstration. Check your collected set before searching for the vault.
troubleshooting: A different room layout is not proof of a bug. This guide gives objectives and landmarks, not a guaranteed identical maze seed.
Collecting relics alone is not the final step: solve the vault, take the key and return to the elevator.
prerequisites: Use the same Roblox account for the task and the Hollow hub.
Guide reviewed from October 23 gameplay; account access and live bug fixes can vary.

name: DOORS Candy Vault: All-Seeking Antlers
description: Reach the end of the Candy Vault’s 50 doors within its 20-minute limit, then return to The Hollow to claim the antlers.
steps: In DOORS, enter the limited-time Estate / Candy Vault mode. This is the event route, not a normal Hotel run.
Approach the mansion, let the opening scenes finish and enter the large vault straight ahead with your team.
Follow the numbered doors and descend through 50 rooms before the 20-minute timer expires. Keep moving toward the next numbered door; optional side rooms can lead back to your route.
At the final large cauldron room, cross to the far side and escape with your team.
Return to The Hollow cinema. Find the All-Seeking Antlers display on the left and use its claim interaction. Completing DOORS and claiming the hub item are separate steps.
tips: WaffleTrades 1:42–2:58 demonstrates the Estate and timed route; 2:58–3:08 explains the hub claim.
20 minutes is the run deadline, not a promise that every player will finish in that time.
troubleshooting: A normal DOORS badge is not the event completion: the official event badge is Sweet Deceit (1035315791189379).
If the claim stays locked, check the event badge on the same account, rejoin the hub and check again. Rejoining is a diagnostic step, not a guaranteed bug fix.
prerequisites: Use the same Roblox account for the task and the Hollow hub.
Guide reviewed from October 23 gameplay; account access and live bug fixes can vary.

name: Racket Rivals: two candy scores and the Trickster badge
description: Score twice during Flick or Treat rounds, claim the Trickster badge, then check Hollow Ticket credit. Includes teammate scoring and missing-basket troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Join Racket Rivals, place 90906407195271, using the same account as The Hollow.
Steps checked from the full October 23 SharkBlox recording on October 24; not our own account playtest.
steps: Approach the Trickster in Racket Rivals and open the Hollow event panel. The objective is CANDY SCORED: 2, not two ordinary match points.
Join a match and wait for its Flick or Treat round. The event panel says these rounds appear in all matches; the special baskets are not permanently present.
Hit the candy into a Trick-or-Treat basket. The creator demonstrates a score and reports that a teammate’s successful shot also contributes to your objective.
Repeat until the Trickster panel reads 2/2. If a missed shot removes the candy opportunity, wait for another event round rather than searching the lobby for candy pickups.
Open the Trickster panel and select Claim. At 1:08 the recording shows CANDY SCORED 2/2 and Claimed. Check for Trickster Badge, ID 527134793936142.

Return to The Hollow and use Confirm for newly earned badge credit. SharkBlox reports 20 Tickets, but this video does not show the hub balance increasing. Check your actual balance before planning a purchase.
tips: Video timestamps: 0:14–0:29 Trickster requirement; 0:29–0:55 basket gameplay; 0:55–1:03 teammate scoring; 1:03–1:12 manual claim.
The 500 reward beside the badge in the Racket Rivals panel is not evidence of 500 Hollow Tickets.
troubleshooting: No baskets visible? Wait for the Flick or Treat phase within a match; ordinary rallies are not the event objective.
Two scores alone are not the final step: return to the event panel and Claim.
Badge ownership does not guarantee immediate Hollow Ticket credit. Existing event credit failures remain reported; repeating the badge is not a verified farming method or fix.
